name: plasmic-antd6-table
description: Display structured records as rows and columns, with registered controls for sorting, filtering, row selection, pagination and expandable detail content. Configure the relevant data and event props for each behavior.
sections:
Table
Display structured records as rows and columns, with registered controls for sorting, filtering, row selection, pagination and expandable detail content. Configure the relevant data and event props for each behavior.

bordered: boolean
children: slot
Allowed children: plasmic-antd6-table-column, plasmic-antd6-table-column-group, plasmic-antd6-table-expand-column
classNames: object
data: dataSourceOpData
expandable: object — Native Ant Design expandable configuration. Add Expanded row content to enable row details. Insert one Table.ExpandColumn among Columns to choose its position; otherwise Ant Design places it automatically. State remains in this object; bind expandedRowKeys and update it from the top-level onExpandedRowsChange event for controlled expansion. Top-level render and event props take precedence over callbacks supplied in expandable.
expandedRowRender: slot — Row detail template receiving row, index, indent and expanded. Mapped to native expandable.expandedRowRender; takes precedence over a renderer in expandable. Use row fields in this slot. Selecting this slot or Edit contents reveals eligible rows through the temporary canvas session without changing runtime expansion. Selecting the Table alone does not reveal rows. The canvas modifier-click gesture changes temporary keys. Requires data and a stable rowKey.
isSelectable: choice
onChange: eventHandler — Receives pagination, filters, sorter and extra. Filters maps column keys (dataIndex when no explicit key) to selected native values or null when cleared. extra.action is paginate, sort or filter; extra.currentDataSource contains the locally sorted and filtered rows before pagination. Omit Column.onFilter for server filtering and use filters to request data. Sorter contains field, columnKey and order (ascend/descend, or undefined when cleared); multiple sorting can return an array. With Column.sorter=true, use these values to request server-sorted data; rows are not reordered locally.
Event arguments: pagination: object, filters: object, sorter: object, extra: object
onExpand: eventHandler — Mapped to native expandable.onExpand(expanded, row). Use MCP createInteraction with eventName onExpand. Top-level handler takes precedence over expandable.onExpand.
Event arguments: expanded: boolean, row: object
onExpandedRowsChange: eventHandler — Mapped to native expandable.onExpandedRowsChange(expandedKeys). Use MCP createInteraction with eventName onExpandedRowsChange to update the state bound to expandable.expandedRowKeys. Top-level handler takes precedence over expandable.onExpandedRowsChange.
Event arguments: expandedKeys: object
onSelectedRowKeysChange: eventHandler
Event arguments: keys: object
onSelectedRowsChange: eventHandler
Event arguments: rows: object
pagination: custom — False hides pagination; otherwise use native pagination options: current, pageSize/defaultPageSize, total, pageSizeOptions, showSizeChanger, and showTotal(total, range) returning content. Bind showTotal to display the total before the pager controls; keep paging and total under this one owner.
rowKey: choice — Choose a unique, stable field to identify rows for selection and expansion.
scroll: custom — Native Ant Design scroll. Horizontal width accepts pixels, percentages, or max-content; unset keeps the table within its container without horizontal scrolling. The table body grows with content when height is unset.
selectedRowKeys: choice
size: choice
styles: object
title: slot — Optional content above the column headers. Receives the current page rows as currentPageData; column headings use Column.title.

name: plasmic-antd6-table-column
description: Define a data or action column inside Table, including its title, data field and cell renderer. Requires the owning Table.
sections:
Table.Column
Define a data or action column inside Table, including its title, data field and cell renderer. Requires the owning Table.
Requires parent: plasmic-antd6-table

align: choice
colSpan: number
dataIndex: string — The data field used by this column. Changes apply to every row.
defaultFilteredValue: exprEditor — Initial array of native filter values. Leave unset for no initial filter. Users own filtering afterward in Preview; canvas edits reflect immediately without persisting controlled state.
defaultSortOrder: choice — Initial sorting direction. Leave unset for no initial sorting. Requires Sorter; users can change the direction by clicking the header in Preview.
ellipsis: exprEditor — Native column ellipsis: false disables truncation; true enables truncation with the browser title; { showTitle: false } keeps truncation without the cell title. For long text, use { showTitle: false } with a Tooltip in Custom render to show the complete cell value. This option does not create the Tooltip itself.
filterDropdown: slot — Optional custom filter panel replacing the native menu. Receives the native filterProps object: selectedKeys, setSelectedKeys(keys), confirm({ closeDropdown }), clearFilters({ confirm, closeDropdown }), close(), filters, visible and prefixCls. Bind controls and actions to these functions; On filter still owns local row matching.
filterDropdownProps: exprEditor — Native Dropdown props object, including placement, trigger, getPopupContainer, open and onOpenChange(open). When controlling open, update its owning state from onOpenChange. Omit open for native trigger behavior.
filterIcon: slot — Optional native filter icon template receiving the filtered boolean. Leave empty for Ant Design's filter icon.
filterMode: choice
filterMultiple: boolean — Allow multiple selected filter values. False uses native single selection.
filterOnClose: boolean — Apply native menu selections when the dropdown closes. False requires confirmation. A custom Filter dropdown owns its confirm/clear behavior.
filterResetToDefaultFilteredValue: boolean — Reset restores Default filtered value when true; otherwise Reset clears the selected values. The native menu applies the reset selection on confirmation or close when Filter on close is enabled.
filterSearch: exprEditor — False (default), true for native option search, or (input, filterItem) => boolean for custom matching. Searches filter options, not table records.
filtered: boolean — Force the filter icon highlight without filtering rows. Actual filtering uses Filtered value or native menu state and On filter.
filteredValue: exprEditor — Controlled array of native filter values. Bind state and update it from Table On change filters using this column's key. Use null or [] to clear; omit for uncontrolled filtering. Takes precedence over Default filtered value.
filters: array — Native filter menu items. Each item has text, value and optional nested children. Values retain their string, number or boolean types. Use a data binding for ReactNode text or a complete nested array. Requires On filter for local filtering; otherwise handle Table On change to fetch server-filtered data.
fixed: choice
onCellClick: eventHandler — Triggered by clicking a button, link, or avatar inside Custom render. Receives the cell value, row, and row index.
